international.title: California braces for more towering waves as powerful storms approach
international.summary: NWS issues advisories for long stretches of the northern California coast, warning that waves can quickly overpower anyone nearby The massive, 50-foot swells along California’s coast this weekend foretold an intense week of towering waves to come. Officials from the National Weather Service (NWS) had issued advisories for long stretches of the California coast, warning people that erratic and unpredictable waves could quickly overpower anyone nearby. The highest waves – which reached 50 to 60ft (15.24 to 18.29 meters) – cracked along the popular Mavericks surf spot in San Mateo county, south of San Francisco. Continue reading...
